title: Mh's KaneP-Backrooms
description: Backrooms TxT made by Michelin on 14th May 26. Remake of previous TxT but with Kane Pixels Backrooms Textures. Made for Roleplay/Video-making purposes.
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d99262830b1bc555e610ea40e6ff78ad4d229b33_0.webp)

## About

**Mh's KaneP-Backrooms** is a re-texture of my previous TxT. . Current version of this texture pack is Alpha 1.0, the only available versions of this texture pack are : 1.21.1, 1.18.

**_I also recommend pairing this with some sort of 64x pack, to make the textures feel more consistent._**

![Recommended](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c024209f6083422ba9f63fa5a592ecfbf3b46c3_0.webp) 

**_For this to work you must put the 64x pack below my pack, as seen in the picture above._**

- _This texture pack is only for roleplay/video use, not gameplay. Best recommended to not have any other texture packs on._
